evidence_required: Literature: edition/version + chapter/page or paragraph locator + short supporting quotation. Video: version + start/end timestamps + description of relevant visual/audio evidence.
annotation_rule: Apply multiple labels when independently supported. Record present, absent, uncertain or not_applicable; absent requires adequate inspection. Store work_id, unit_id, pattern_id, evidence, rationale, modality and reviewer in annotation records. Never infer absence from an uninspected segment.
sequence_recording: For sequential patterns record linked event IDs in presentation order and, where recoverable, story order; identify setup, expectation, disruption, reveal and consequence only where evidenced.
